About Electron apps (Discord, Slack, Teams for Linux, Signal, VS Code…):
- Electron 38 and later pick Wayland automatically when it is available (ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT
is deprecated); older Electron apps need --ozone-platform-hint=auto to run natively.
